annotations.title: Make a sting from chosen website parts

description: Makes a 12-second, 8-scene film from the page parts you choose (node_ids from ugcfans_get_capture), in the chosen frame. Unlike a launch film its page text stays as editable text, so ugcfans_set_film_words can change it. Free of credits. Returns the film and its first revision at once.

key_phrase.description: A phrase of the chosen text to feature. It must appear in the chosen parts.

node_ids.description: The node_id of each part to include, from ugcfans_get_capture.
